# Glossary: the words of a story, and where they are in the suite

The words on the site's links (what a BA writes in a story) and the page class and method each leads
to. From the crawl: the header and footer links, links between pages, and the page types' names.

| Words in a story | Page class | How a test gets there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `About` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#about` section (a link on the start page) |
| `Work` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#work` section (a link on the start page) |
| `Journey` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#journey` section (a link on the start page) |
| `Contact` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#contact` section (a link on the start page) |
| `Zenkai` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` (a link on the start page) |
| `Then I stay ↓` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#about` section (a link on the start page) |
| `Show all 28 rooms →` | JourneyPage | `new HomePage(page).open().click().goToJourney()`, or `new JourneyPage(page).open()` (a link on the start page) |
| `Show all 28 rooms →` | JourneyPage | `new HomePage(page).open().click().goToJourney()` |
| `About` | HomePage | `new JourneyPage(page).open().click().goToHome()` |
| Home | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` |
| Journey | JourneyPage | `new JourneyPage(page).open()` |
